description: Create a rate-limit rule from structured fields. The running app enforces it within about 10 seconds and answers 429 with Retry-After once the limit is reached. keyBy picks what each bucket counts: ip (default), global (one shared bucket), header (one bucket per value of keyName, e.g. x-api-key) or cookie (one bucket per value of keyName, e.g. session). Several rules can stack on one route (for example a burst limit and an hourly cap). Write action; requires confirmation.

appKey.description: Optional application key. Omit for all apps.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

duration.description: Optional rule lifetime, for example 2h or 7d. Omit for no expiry.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry time as ISO 8601 instead of duration.

ip.description: Optional IPv4 address or CIDR the rule applies to. Omit for any IP.

keyBy.description: What each bucket counts. Defaults to ip.

keyName.description: Header or cookie name when keyBy is header or cookie, for example x-api-key or session.

method.description: HTTP method scope. Defaults to ALL.

pathMatchMode.description: Path matching mode. Defaults to prefix.

pathPattern.description: Route pattern, for example /api/auth/login or /api/. A rule needs a route, an IP, or both.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

status.description: Create it disabled to stage it. Defaults to active.

name: securenow_rate_limit_create
title: Create Rate Limit
